data.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 2:3 Pinterest editorial image
Primary request: Create a refined editorial kitchen photograph in which the exact compact pizza cutter from Image 1 hangs naturally among a small, meticulously arranged set of real chef's tools; its miniature circular-saw shape creates the visual double take. This must feel like a saveable design-magazine photograph, never an advertisement.
Input images: Image 1 is the sole product-truth reference. Preserve the cutter's distinctive ordinary six-inch scale, compact blue front motor-like housing, gray rear/top handle, one exposed round stainless-steel cutting wheel with center fastener, and broad gray lower guard/plate. It is a hand-held pizza wheel shaped like a miniature circular saw, not a powered saw and not a full-size construction tool.
Scene/backdrop: warm plaster-and-wood trattoria prep corner with one narrow oak utensil rail or pegboard, a restrained set of five or six genuine kitchen tools, and a freshly baked pizza on the counter directly below.
Subject: the exact blue-and-gray saw-shaped pizza wheel is the central interloper on the rail, clearly visible at natural six-inch scale, surrounded only by normal kitchen tools such as a wooden spoon, metal whisk, small ladle, and dough scraper.
Style/medium: highly realistic natural editorial interior photography, tactile and sophisticated, not surreal illustration or catalog staging.
Composition/framing: vertical 2:3; tool rail in the upper-middle and pizza prep surface below; the cutter occupies enough area to inspect; one clear visual idea; balanced asymmetry; no empty headline zone and no template-like layout.
Lighting/mood: soft side window light, late-afternoon warmth, gentle real shadows, calm and quietly funny.
Materials/textures: aged oak, matte plaster, brushed stainless steel, worn wood handles, matte blue and gray engineering plastic, crisp pizza crust.
Text: none. Do not invent, render, or emphasize any lettering, logo, packaging, label, headline, badge, button, or call to action.
Constraints: product geometry and scale must remain faithful to Image 1; exactly one saw-shaped cutter; exactly one circular cutting wheel on it; keep its lower guard/plate and center fastener; no construction tools other than the pizza cutter's playful silhouette; the cutter must hang or rest physically plausibly; no people or hands; no deceptive extra features.
Avoid: a real construction saw, giant tool scale, extra blades, duplicated tools, blade teeth, power cords, batteries, sparks, sawdust, weapons, gore, floating objects, showroom packshot, ad copy, Pinterest template, watermark, pseudo text.
data.changesFromParent: A deliberately different context-first tool-wall execution rather than a close food still life.
notes: Generated separately as a distinct execution.
The repository copy was inspected at full useful resolution.
